name: Version history
description: Saves versions of your vault with Git, set up by default: automatic commits after you stop writing, one commit per agent turn, a History tab per file with diffs and Restore, and `writer git:*` for agents. Add a remote to sync across devices: fetch, replay and push with merges that understand notes.

memory.note: One sleeping thread that checks once a second; a status check runs in a short Rust call. Sync runs git as a child process while it works.

offNotes.agent.turn-started: Your pending edits won't be saved before an agent turn
offNotes.agent.turn-baseline: Files a shell command changes won't show a diff
offNotes.agent.turn-finished: Agent turns won't be saved in history

commands.label: Show history
commands.description: Open the version history of the active file

commands.label: Resolve conflicts
commands.description: Open the merge view of a file two devices changed

secrets.label: Git token
secrets.description: The personal access token used for HTTPS remotes (SSH uses your own keys).
